findings.title: SQL Injection in category parameter leads to admin credential dump and flag extraction
findings.description: The `category` GET parameter in index.php is directly interpolated into a MySQL query without parameterization. An attacker can use error-based and time-based blind SQL injection to enumerate the database, dump the `admins` table (credentials: admin / ONEverySecurePassword_!), and login to admin.php to retrieve the CTF flag.
